connection_count.operation: Count every retained event in the global capture-day/60-second bucket.

unique_destination_count.operation: Count distinct nonempty destination IP values.

unique_destination_port_count.operation: Count distinct nonzero destination ports, matching the existing implementation.

originator_bytes_sum.operation: Sum the corresponding connection-level payload bytes or packet counts.

responder_bytes_sum.operation: Sum the corresponding connection-level payload bytes or packet counts.

originator_packets_sum.operation: Sum the corresponding connection-level payload bytes or packet counts.

responder_packets_sum.operation: Sum the corresponding connection-level payload bytes or packet counts.

protocol_tcp_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of tcp/udp/icmp.

protocol_udp_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of tcp/udp/icmp.

protocol_icmp_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of tcp/udp/icmp.

protocol_other_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of tcp/udp/icmp.

service_dns_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of dns/http/ssl/ssh.

service_http_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of dns/http/ssl/ssh.

service_ssl_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of dns/http/ssl/ssh.

service_ssh_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of dns/http/ssl/ssh.

service_other_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of dns/http/ssl/ssh.

state_sf_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of SF/S0/REJ/RSTO/RSTR.

state_s0_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of SF/S0/REJ/RSTO/RSTR.

state_rej_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of SF/S0/REJ/RSTO/RSTR.

state_rsto_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of SF/S0/REJ/RSTO/RSTR.

state_rstr_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of SF/S0/REJ/RSTO/RSTR.

state_other_fraction.operation: Fraction of all retained connections in the named category; other is the complement of SF/S0/REJ/RSTO/RSTR.

grouping: UTC capture day and floor(ts/60), merged across all source files; no source-IP partition is introduced.
category_missing_value_policy: Empty or dash categories become missing and contribute to the existing other fractions; no record is dropped merely for unknown service.
limitations: Processed release completeness does not establish recovery of every original raw capture event.
Record counts are CSV occurrences; cross-file join multiplicity and exact connection identities require a separate audit.
Missing numeric values require an explicit policy and sensitivity analysis before claiming representation equivalence.
Binary labels remain separate from attack types; no forced MITRE mapping is performed.
Timestamp and duration units must be checked against official source documentation; a declared unit alone is not evidence.
